portion_mae_audit.discrepancy_explanation: The 70.93g value cited in NUTRITION_EVALUATION_REPORT.md was an inadvertent typo/confusion with RandomForest's test MAE (70.807g) and HistGradientBoosting's validation MAE (75.52g). The true test MAE of the selected portion regressor in metrics.json is 61.61g.
